items.headline: Albemarle price target lowered to $225 from $245 at Truist
items.snippet: Truist analyst Peter Osterland lowered the firm's price target on Albemarle to $225 from $245 and keeps a Buy rating on the shares, citing resilient lithium demand and constrained supply dynamics despite a discounted valuation.
